mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months signals monetary easing, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals weak economic conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening that increases discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 3.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals strong labor market conditions and rising consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500.0 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand for durable goods, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 500.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months signals broad-based consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate output growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
